description.zh-CN: 允许管理器直接启动清单中登记并校验过 sha256 的本机程序（如 llama-server.exe），而不是容器。默认关闭；开启前请确认程序来源可信。修改后需要重启两个管理器。
description.en-US: Lets the managers start a local program that the runtime manifest registers and whose sha256 matches (for example llama-server.exe) instead of a container. Off by default; turn it on only for a trusted binary. A change needs both managers restarted.
